title: Environ may be None after removal of _get_environ
detail: The original code used _get_environ to convert a Request or WSGIEnvironment into a plain environ dict. After removal, if get_response is called with environ=None, the code skips conversion and later uses environ, leading to a TypeError when accessing attributes of None.

title: Blocking call in async context
detail: The _loader coroutine is async but calls the blocking Queue.get() method, which will block the event loop and freeze the UI. It should await the async get() method instead.
note: Says `load_queue.get()` should be awaited, though it takes the call for a blocking one.
